tasks.short: Calculate tax liabilities and populate returns from verified client information and approved tax positions.

steps.what: Read client documents and approved tax positions to assemble the calculation workpaper.

loop.input: Client documents, verified case record and approved tax positions.
loop.output: Calculation workpaper with source references and unresolved fields.
loop.check: Validate identifiers, periods, amounts and totals; retain a source reference for every extracted figure.
loop.stop: At most two extraction passes per document; unresolved or conflicting fields go to the preparer.
loop.why_not_simpler: Structured imports handle known formats; varied statements and correspondence require bounded text extraction.

steps.what: Enter workpaper amounts and approved positions into tax preparation software in the {OTHER}.
Run calculations and populate forms in tax preparation software in the {OTHER}.
Reconcile return totals against workpapers and prior-year amounts in the {SPREADSHEET}.
Resolve exceptions and approve the return for client review in the {OTHER}.

tasks.design: Configured imports feed verified amounts into tax preparation software in the {OTHER}; a bounded extractor prepares unfamiliar documents from the {DOCS}. Deterministic checks on the {DATA_PLATFORM} reconcile the draft and create an exception queue in the {WORKFLOW}. The preparer approves release for client review; filing requires a separate authorised action.
tasks.previous_blocker: Calculation software already handles much of the arithmetic. Variable documents, duplicate entry and disconnected workpapers leave manual work around it.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing import functions and faster development of mappings and reconciliation checks reduce setup effort. Bounded extraction can handle variable documents when every figure remains traceable.
tasks.still_hard: Maintaining jurisdiction-specific rules, handling amended returns and resolving inconsistent evidence remain costly. The solution depends on maintained tax software rather than rebuilding tax law.
tasks.human_edge: The preparer recognises when apparently valid figures represent the wrong tax treatment and accepts responsibility for the reviewed return.

ambition.what: Review a client's estimated year-end liability after each quarterly bookkeeping close.

tasks.altitude: The week shifts from entry and arithmetic to exception resolution and quarterly liability reviews. No new filing authority follows automatically; the preparer can propose earlier reviews within the engagement.

reach.task: Reconcile the closing ledger to the tax calculation workpaper.
reach.learn: Learn ledger account mapping, cut-off checks and the treatment of book-to-tax differences.

evidence.claim: AFAS Jonas assists with income and corporate tax returns while leaving the user responsible.
Baker Tilly Netherlands reports faster statement checks and tests of details using DataSnipper; these are vendor-reported audit outcomes, not tax-return outcomes.
Tax arithmetic and form population are usually existing software capabilities; additional gains come from imports and exception checks.

assumptions: The setting is a tax services practice with 200 to 2,000 staff serving individuals and small businesses.
The first release covers one jurisdiction and a small set of supported return types.
The {OTHER} is maintained tax preparation software with supported imports.
Time shares and remaining percentages are design estimates, not observed measurements.
The near-total automation prior fits arithmetic better than the complete task, which includes source validation and approval.
Build ranges cover an incremental solution and access review, including employee consultation where national rules apply.
unknowns: Which return types, jurisdictions and tax software versions the practice uses.
Whether supported imports and calculation exports are available.
How often source documents conflict or require corrections.
Who may approve client release and subsequent filing.
research_questions: Which supported import formats preserve source references and tax rule versions?
Which official validation checks can be reproduced independently without duplicating the tax engine?
new_work: Review extracted fields and resolve document conflicts.
Maintain account mappings and regression cases for annual rule changes.
Investigate failed imports and reconcile corrected records.
Review access, retention and employee consultation requirements under GDPR and national rules; assess EU AI Act duties for the intended use.
tasks.statement: Compute taxes owed or overpaid, using adding machines or personal computers, and complete entries on forms, following tax form instructions and tax tables.

tasks.short: Prepare individual and small-business tax returns from financial records and supporting documents.

steps.what: Collect financial records and supporting documents into the client file.
Read documents and enter supported amounts into tax preparation software {OTHER}.

loop.input: Documents without structured equivalents in the tax source pack.
loop.output: Typed amounts, dates and identifiers with page references.
loop.check: Validate taxpayer, period, currency, duplicate documents and document totals; review uncertain fields.
loop.stop: One extraction and one repair per document; unresolved fields enter a manual queue.
loop.why_not_simpler: Use imports and fixed templates first; varied free-text documents still need interpretation.

steps.what: Reconcile source amounts with financial records and investigate differences.
Choose tax treatments and document material judgements.
Populate forms and calculate liabilities in tax preparation software {OTHER}.
Review the return and approve the client-ready return pack.

tasks.design: Configure imports, calculations and form generation in tax preparation software {OTHER}, with source documents in {DOCS}. A bounded extractor handles unsupported documents, while deterministic reconciliation on the {DATA_PLATFORM} produces exceptions and linked workpapers. The senior tax preparer approves the client-ready pack; client authorisation and filing remain separate actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Tax software already calculates liabilities. Fragmented documents, inconsistent imports and undocumented treatment choices leave substantial preparation outside it.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing import features and faster development of mappings and reconciliation checks make the missing connections cheaper. Bounded extraction can handle varied documents with source references.
tasks.still_hard: Cross-border facts, disputed classifications, incomplete evidence and annual national tax changes still require expertise.
tasks.human_edge: Understand the client's circumstances, distinguish defensible treatments and explain the consequences of uncertain positions.

ambition.what: Quarterly estimated-tax refresh for small-business clients.

tasks.altitude: The week shifts toward exceptions, treatment choices and client discussions. With agreed delegation, the preparer can prioritise quarterly estimate reviews; statutory signing authority does not change.

reach.task: Resolve ledger classifications that cause recurring tax adjustments.
reach.learn: Account mappings, adjusting entries and close controls.

evidence.claim: AFAS Jonas provides assistance within income and corporate tax returns; the user remains responsible.
Tax arithmetic and form population should use maintained rules and validated mappings, with models limited to document interpretation.
The build ranges are planning estimates, not demonstrated delivery times or a guaranteed coding speed increase.

assumptions: The setting is a tax-services team within a European firm employing 200 to 2,000 people.
Tax preparation software {OTHER} supports maintained national tax rules and usable imports.
This task ends with a reviewed return pack; it excludes client authorisation and filing.
GDPR applies to client data. EU AI Act duties require a use-specific assessment; credit-scoring classifications do not automatically apply to tax preparation.
Access estimates include employee consultation where national rules require it; statutory waiting periods may extend elapsed time.
Step times and remaining time are planning estimates. Document handling drives effort, while calculations already use software.
unknowns: Which jurisdictions, return types and tax years the team supports.
Available import interfaces, licences and source-data quality.
Who may approve treatments, release packs and submit returns.
Applicable employee consultation arrangements and approved data-processing locations.
research_questions: Which official schemas and maintained calculation interfaces cover the target returns?
Which national rules govern preparer responsibility, record retention and employee consultation?
new_work: Review uncertain extracted fields and reconcile missing source documents.
Maintain document mappings and versioned national tax rules.
Regression-check calculations and return mappings after annual updates.
Monitor access, retention and extraction-provider changes.
tasks.statement: Prepare or assist in preparing simple to complex tax returns for individuals or small businesses.

tasks.short: Identify lawful adjustments, deductions and credits, then select supported tax positions with the client.

steps.what: Read the client file for facts that may support deductions, credits or adjustments.

loop.input: Client evidence and a maintained catalogue of potential tax reliefs.
loop.output: Relief candidate list with supporting facts, source references and missing evidence.
loop.check: Every candidate must cite client evidence and an applicable catalogue entry; unsupported candidates are excluded.
loop.stop: One classification pass and one repair pass per case; uncertain matches go to the preparer.
loop.why_not_simpler: Eligibility filters are deterministic, but narrative evidence describes relevant facts in varied language.

steps.what: Check eligibility conditions and evidence requirements against current guidance in the {DOCS}.
Calculate supported alternatives in tax preparation software in the {OTHER}.
Discuss choices, missing evidence and consequences with the client.
Approve supported positions and record rationale in tax preparation software in the {OTHER}.

tasks.design: A maintained eligibility catalogue in the {DOCS} supplies deterministic checks on the {DATA_PLATFORM}; a bounded reader links narrative client evidence to possible reliefs. Tax preparation software in the {OTHER} calculates supported alternatives, while the {WORKFLOW} tracks missing evidence. The preparer discusses choices and approves positions before they enter the working return.
tasks.previous_blocker: Client facts are scattered across documents, and eligibility conditions change by jurisdiction and year. Standard software calculates entered claims but does not establish every supporting fact.
tasks.enabler_now: Small evidence-matching loops and reusable eligibility checks make a candidate workpaper practical. Faster implementation reduces the cost of connecting that workpaper to existing scenario calculations.
tasks.still_hard: Ambiguous eligibility, interactions between reliefs and uncertain client facts need professional judgement. A lower tax amount alone does not establish that a position is lawful or suitable.
tasks.human_edge: The preparer interprets uncertain facts, weighs defensibility and explains consequences the client may otherwise overlook.

ambition.what: Offer a pre-year-end relief planning review to small-business clients.

tasks.altitude: The preparer spends less time searching files and more time assessing alternatives before deadlines. They gain room to recommend a planning review; approval authority remains subject to the practice's existing limits.

reach.task: Plan cash availability for estimated tax payments.
reach.learn: Learn cash forecasting and how tax elections change payment timing as well as total liability.

evidence.claim: AFAS Jonas provides assistance within income and corporate tax preparation; the digest does not establish autonomous relief selection.
Known eligibility conditions and scenario arithmetic can be encoded, while ambiguous tax positions require professional review.

assumptions: The initial catalogue covers common reliefs in one jurisdiction and tax year.
Qualified tax staff maintain the catalogue and approve its legal interpretation.
Time shares and remaining percentages are design estimates.
The judgement-heavy prior is credible; automation addresses evidence matching and calculation more strongly than position selection.
Build ranges include access review and any employee consultation required by national rules.
unknowns: Which reliefs dominate the client portfolio.
Which positions require senior tax adviser approval.
Whether the {OTHER} supports separate scenario records.
How much time currently goes into eligibility research and evidence chasing.
research_questions: Which relief conditions can be encoded reliably from authoritative guidance?
How should conflicting guidance and effective dates be represented without implying certainty?
new_work: Maintain relief conditions, effective dates and authoritative references.
Review missed and irrelevant candidate reliefs.
Resolve incomplete evidence and route ambiguous positions to a senior tax adviser.
Maintain scenario isolation so exploratory alternatives cannot overwrite approved positions.
Apply GDPR controls to client evidence and assess EU AI Act duties for the intended use.
tasks.statement: Use all appropriate adjustments, deductions, and credits to keep clients' taxes to a minimum.

tasks.short: Interview clients to clarify income, expenses, allowances and gaps in their tax evidence.

steps.what: Review the client file and prepare questions about missing or inconsistent facts.

loop.input: Client documents, prior-year facts and outstanding evidence requests.
loop.output: Interview brief with referenced inconsistencies and suggested questions.
loop.check: Every factual premise must cite the file; checklist gaps are calculated deterministically.
loop.stop: One draft and one repair pass; unsupported premises are removed and uncertainty is shown.
loop.why_not_simpler: Fixed checklists find missing fields, but narrative conflicts need reading and case-specific questions.

steps.what: Arrange the interview through the {EMAIL} and {CALENDAR}.
Ask follow-up questions and take notes during the client interview.
Turn interview notes into a case summary and evidence request in the {DOCS}.

loop.input: The preparer's written interview notes and existing case fields.
loop.output: Draft case update and evidence request, separating client statements from verified facts.
loop.check: Every update cites a note; reconcile amounts and dates, and preserve uncertainty explicitly.
loop.stop: One extraction and one repair pass; ambiguous notes remain unresolved for the preparer.
loop.why_not_simpler: Written notes vary in wording and structure; fixed forms remain available for routine facts.

steps.what: Validate case updates and release the evidence request in tax software in the {OTHER}.

tasks.design: The {WORKFLOW} prepares a referenced interview brief from the {DOCS} and configures booking through the {CALENDAR}. The preparer conducts the interview and supplies written notes; a bounded extractor drafts case updates and evidence requests. Approval commits the updates to tax preparation software in the {OTHER} and releases the request through the {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: The interview depends on trust and adaptive questioning, while preparation and note transfer are scattered. Automating the entire conversation offered little benefit and introduced verification problems.
tasks.enabler_now: Brief generation, configured scheduling and bounded extraction from written notes can reduce the surrounding administration. These changes do not require an autonomous interviewer or call recording.
tasks.still_hard: Clients may be unsure, embarrassed or inconsistent about financial facts. A statement obtained in an interview may still require documentary evidence.
tasks.human_edge: The preparer builds trust, notices hesitation and asks follow-up questions that reveal facts missing from the paperwork.

ambition.what: Provide assisted intake for first-time small-business clients with incomplete records.

tasks.altitude: Most interview time remains human; preparation and follow-up consume less of the week. The preparer can spend that capacity on assisted intake and request stronger evidence, while tax-position approval rights remain unchanged.

reach.task: Organise incomplete income and expense records before tax preparation.
reach.learn: Learn document classification, basic reconciliations and how to distinguish an assertion from supporting evidence.

evidence.claim: The digest identifies interviews as work that stays with people.
Configured booking and reviewed extraction from written notes can reduce interview administration without automating the conversation.

assumptions: Interviews are conducted by telephone, video or in person; the modelled case uses a call.
The extractor uses written notes and does not depend on audio recording.
Scheduling uses authorised contacts, approved invitation text and available appointment slots.
The high vanishing prior is rejected for the conversation: the task retains its relationship and fact-finding purpose.
Time shares and remaining percentages are design estimates.
Build ranges include access review and any employee consultation required by national rules.
unknowns: How much interview time currently goes into preparation and follow-up.
Whether notes are already structured and stored with the case.
Which clients need assisted intake or language support.
Whether case software can preserve the distinction between asserted and verified facts.
research_questions: Which note fields best preserve uncertainty and the source of client statements?
What retention and access controls apply when notes include special-category personal data?
new_work: Review interview briefs for misleading premises.
Validate drafted case updates against written notes.
Track requested evidence and distinguish outstanding assertions from verified facts.
Maintain intake checklists and booking rules.
Apply GDPR controls to interview records and assess relevant EU AI Act duties and consultation requirements under national rules.
tasks.statement: Interview clients to obtain additional information on taxable income and deductible expenses and allowances.

tasks.short: Review financial records to determine the forms and schedules required for a tax return.

steps.what: Retrieve financial statements and expenditure evidence from the client file.
Read records to identify income, expenditure, ownership and jurisdiction facts.

loop.input: Unstructured records not already represented in the tax source index.
loop.output: Evidence-linked facts, document categories and explicitly missing facts.
loop.check: Validate taxpayer, tax year and cited passages; distinguish absent evidence from a negative answer.
loop.stop: One extraction and one repair per document; conflicting or unsupported facts go to the preparer.
loop.why_not_simpler: Rules handle structured exports; narrative notes and unfamiliar document layouts require reading.

steps.what: Match identified facts against national form and schedule requirements.
Resolve ambiguous filing obligations and approve the required forms.
Record the approved form checklist in tax preparation software {OTHER}.

tasks.design: Reuse the tax source index in {DOCS}, extracting only facts missing from structured records. A versioned decision table on the {DATA_PLATFORM} maps verified facts to national form requirements and flags uncertainty. Approved requirements populate the checklist in tax preparation software {OTHER}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Form requirements depend on facts spread across documents, while checklists often hide the reasons behind a selection.
tasks.enabler_now: Evidence-linked extraction can populate a stable fact schema. Deterministic decision tables can then provide reproducible selections and explicit exceptions.
tasks.still_hard: Residency, ownership changes and cross-border obligations can require facts that financial statements do not contain.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when apparently routine records conceal a different filing obligation and ask the decisive follow-up question.

ambition.what: Reassess required schedules when a material client fact changes.

tasks.altitude: The preparer spends less time reading unchanged records and more time resolving incomplete facts. They can initiate a scope review when new facts appear; final scope approval follows existing delegation.

reach.task: Maintain an evidence-backed register of filing obligations and deadlines.
reach.learn: Obligation ownership, jurisdiction tracking and change-control methods.

evidence.claim: Evidence-linked extraction followed by jurisdiction-specific decision tables is a proposed design, not a demonstrated tax-form selection case in the digest.
A missing source fact should trigger an exception rather than an inferred absence of a filing obligation.

assumptions: A shared source index is reused across preparation and form selection; extraction is not built twice.
The first release covers a defined set of national return types.
Judgement remains concentrated in ambiguous obligations despite routine evidence gathering becoming automated.
Access work includes GDPR controls and employee consultation where national rules require it.
unknowns: Whether existing tax preparation software {OTHER} already provides adequate form-selection rules.
Which factual triggers cause the team's most frequent missed schedules.
Whether client records include residency, ownership and foreign-income facts.
Whether a shared source index already exists.
research_questions: Which official instructions define mandatory schedules and their triggering facts?
Can existing configuration cover those triggers before a custom decision table is built?
new_work: Maintain dated form triggers and their official sources.
Review conflicting facts and unresolved document categories.
Check for missed forms after national rule changes.
Deduplicate extraction and source-index updates across tasks.
tasks.statement: Review financial records, such as income statements and documentation of expenditures to determine forms needed to prepare tax returns.

tasks.short: Explain tax form requirements and give clients advice that helps them provide correct information.

steps.what: Read the client's question and identify the relevant return fields in the {EMAIL}.

loop.input: Client question and authorised case context.
loop.output: Question brief with relevant fields, missing facts and a routine or specialist route.
loop.check: Check client and tax year; require a quoted question and valid return-field references.
loop.stop: One classification and one repair pass; uncertain or consequential questions route to the preparer.
loop.why_not_simpler: Clients describe form problems in free text that does not match fixed field names.

steps.what: Find current instructions and relevant case evidence in the {DOCS}.
Write case-specific instructions and explanations in the {DOCS}.

loop.input: Question brief, current source pack and approved case facts.
loop.output: Draft client advice with field instructions, references and explicit unresolved questions.
loop.check: Check every tax claim against the source pack and every amount against the case; flag unsupported statements.
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; unresolved claims remain flagged for the preparer.
loop.why_not_simpler: Approved templates handle fixed instructions; varied client questions need a short case-specific explanation.

steps.what: Review and send written advice through the {EMAIL}.
Explain difficult points and check the client's understanding during a call.

tasks.design: An answer desk connects client questions in the {EMAIL} to a versioned guidance index and authorised case documents in the {DOCS}. Bounded classification and drafting produce a referenced response for preparer approval, and the {WORKFLOW} records follow-up questions. Difficult explanations stay with the preparer, supported by the same source pack.
tasks.previous_blocker: Guidance search and case-specific explanation were separate manual activities. Generic answers could miss the client's tax year, facts or actual misunderstanding.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned retrieval and bounded drafting make sourced preparation practical. Fixed field identifiers and approved templates keep routine instructions inexpensive.
tasks.still_hard: Detecting misunderstanding, explaining uncertain law and adapting to language or numeracy needs remain demanding. Advice quality depends on current guidance and complete client facts.
tasks.human_edge: The preparer notices confusion, asks a better question and helps the client understand the consequence of an answer.

ambition.what: Offer a guided first-return session for newly self-employed clients.

tasks.altitude: The week shifts from repeated guidance searches and drafting to shorter reviews and focused explanations. The preparer can recommend guided sessions; no additional authority to settle tax positions is implied.

reach.task: Review client guidance for accuracy and required disclosures.
reach.learn: Learn guidance version control, disclosure requirements and escalation criteria.

evidence.claim: The digest documents an assistant in tax preparation, but does not demonstrate an end-to-end taxpayer advice desk.
Source retrieval, approved templates and reviewed drafting can reduce preparation work while leaving difficult explanations human.

assumptions: Guidance can be indexed by jurisdiction, tax year and return field.
This task starts with a client question; telephone-originated questions follow the same preparation path.
The mail prior is weak: written questions and written release make {EMAIL} a material part of this workflow.
Time shares and remaining percentages are design estimates.
The elimination prior applies to repeated lookup and boilerplate more than to client understanding.
Build ranges include access review and employee consultation where national rules require it.
unknowns: The actual mix of written questions, calls and appointments.
Which languages and accessibility needs the clients have.
Whether current guidance has stable identifiers and usable access rights.
Which advice requires a senior tax adviser to approve release.
research_questions: How can guidance updates invalidate affected draft answers automatically?
Which answer checks detect unsupported tax claims and incorrect field references?
new_work: Review drafted advice before release.
Maintain guidance versions, approved templates and question routing.
Investigate answers that clients repeatedly misunderstand.
Check retrieval permissions and retention under GDPR, and assess applicable EU AI Act duties.
tasks.statement: Furnish taxpayers with sufficient information and advice to ensure correct tax form completion.

tasks.short: Research tax procedures for unusual returns.

steps.what: Define the unusual issue, jurisdiction, tax year and missing facts.
Search handbooks, official bulletins and previously documented treatments.
Read relevant passages and compare conditions, exclusions and effective dates.

loop.input: Retrieved passages, source metadata, research question and relevant client facts.
loop.output: Comparison of conditions, exclusions, dates and unresolved conflicts with exact citations.
loop.check: Verify quotations against source text and dates against metadata; the preparer reads decisive passages.
loop.stop: One comparison and one correction pass; absent or conflicting sources trigger manual reading.
loop.why_not_simpler: Keyword search cannot reliably compare qualifications expressed differently across legal prose.

steps.what: Choose the preparation procedure and resolve remaining legal uncertainty.
Record the chosen procedure, supporting citations and outstanding conditions.

tasks.design: Configure a searchable source library in {DOCS} with jurisdiction, effective dates and links to the {GOV_PORTAL}. A bounded loop prepares a cited comparison, while the tax preparer chooses the treatment; a template then records that approved choice in {DOCS} and the tax preparation system in {OTHER}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Source collections had uneven metadata, and legal qualifications required careful reading. Reusable research notes were difficult to find.
tasks.enabler_now: Search configuration, source indexing and template generation are established tools. A bounded model can compare retrieved passages while preserving their provenance.
tasks.still_hard: Access to licensed sources, historical versions and conflicting interpretations remains costly. GDPR requires controlled use of client facts; national rules govern professional responsibilities.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when a superficially similar precedent does not apply and decide when specialist advice is needed.

ambition.what: Internal atypical-return consultation desk for bookkeeping staff.

tasks.altitude: The preparer spends less time searching and more time testing interpretations. They can provide documented consultations to bookkeeping staff, while existing escalation limits still apply.

reach.task: Assess how an unusual tax treatment affects accounting entries and disclosures.
reach.learn: Book-to-tax differences, supporting workpapers and disclosure materiality.

evidence.claim: Search, source metadata and templates can reduce research administration without deciding legal applicability.
AFAS Jonas provides assistance within tax returns while leaving responsibility with the user; it does not establish reliable atypical-return legal research.

assumptions: Most source reading is digital, consistent with the document-heavy prior.
Search assistance offers gains even though selecting an atypical treatment remains human.
Existing search configuration is sufficient once sources have usable metadata.
The tax preparer may approve treatments within existing competence limits.
unknowns: Source licensing terms and availability of historical versions.
The practice's specialist escalation and second-review thresholds.
Whether existing research notes contain reusable, verified citations.
Whether national rules require employee consultation for the planned tools.
research_questions: Can retrieval find all decisive exclusions in a sample of past atypical returns?
Which sources need manual indexing or access?
What makes a treatment note reusable without exposing client information?
new_work: Maintain source dates, versions and licensing permissions.
Review comparisons and escalate uncertain interpretations.
Retire treatment notes when law or official guidance changes.
Check retrieval failures against completed research cases.
tasks.statement: Consult tax law handbooks or bulletins to determine procedures for preparation of atypical returns.

tasks.short: Calculate preparation fees from return complexity and required processing time.

steps.what: Review return features and processing-time records in the tax preparation system.
Consult the applicable fee schedule and engagement terms.
Calculate the base fee, complexity supplements and time charges.
Assess discounts, unusual effort and departures from agreed pricing.
Record the approved fee and calculation basis for billing.

tasks.design: A small fee calculator on the {DATA_PLATFORM} combines return features from the tax preparation system in {OTHER}, time records from {PROJECT} and versioned fee rules held in {WORKFLOW}. It produces an explainable calculation, routes pricing departures to the authorised person and writes the approved fee to the {ERP}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Complexity categories and engagement exceptions were not consistently encoded. Manual transfers connected return records, time records and billing.
tasks.enabler_now: Rules, forms and integrations can be built quickly with AI-assisted coding. The calculation itself needs ordinary arithmetic and versioned pricing rules.
tasks.still_hard: Estimating effort before work begins and handling ambiguous engagement terms remain judgement calls. Poor time records weaken profitability analysis.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish legitimate extra scope from avoidable rework and negotiate a fair fee.

ambition.what: Weekly review of preparation margin by return type.

tasks.altitude: The preparer handles scope and pricing exceptions instead of rebuilding fee calculations. With explicit delegation, they can adjust fees within approved bands; broader pricing changes remain with the practice manager.

reach.task: Review service margins and recommend changes to preparation fees.
reach.learn: Cost allocation, realised hourly rates and pricing sensitivity.

reach.task: Turn approved fee records into accurate invoices.
reach.learn: Billing codes, adjustment handling and duplicate prevention.

evidence.claim: Fee arithmetic and rule selection can use deterministic code when complexity categories and engagement terms are structured.
Negotiated discounts and uncertain scope require judgement; the digest provides no direct fee-calculation case.

assumptions: A spreadsheet often connects fee rules to tax and time records in this setting.
Routine calculations have higher rule coverage than the judgement-heavy prior suggests.
The preparer approves fees within existing limits and escalates larger departures.
Engagement exceptions are encoded by a person rather than interpreted by a model.
unknowns: Whether existing systems already support the required fee rules.
Which fees use fixed prices, actual time or estimated time.
How reliably staff record processing time and return complexity.
Who may approve discounts and pricing departures.
Whether time-data reuse needs consultation under national rules.
research_questions: How many historical fees can the current schedule reproduce exactly?
Which complexity features predict effort without subjective scoring?
Can existing configuration remove the need for a custom calculator?
new_work: Maintain fee schedules, effective dates and exception thresholds.
Correct missing complexity fields and unreliable time records.
Review pricing departures and monitor fee-to-invoice reconciliation.
Maintain integrations and calculation regression checks.
tasks.statement: Calculate form preparation fees according to return complexity and processing time required.

tasks.short: Check others' tax-return inputs, totals and procedures against source records.

steps.what: Open the draft return, workpapers and supporting evidence.
Recalculate totals and inspect validation messages in tax preparation software {OTHER}.
Compare return fields with source documents and the procedural checklist.
Discuss exceptions with the preparer and agree necessary corrections.
Confirm corrections and sign off the return check report.

tasks.design: Enable native validations in tax preparation software {OTHER}, then add deterministic source-to-field and checklist checks on the {DATA_PLATFORM}. Results link to evidence in {DOCS}; corrections trigger a rerun and invalidate stale checks. The reviewer resolves exceptions and signs the check report before final return approval.
tasks.previous_blocker: Native checks catch arithmetic errors but often lack links to external evidence. Reviewers bridge those gaps manually.
tasks.enabler_now: Structured source indexes and inexpensive field mappings allow repeatable comparisons. Existing validation features can cover arithmetic without a model.
tasks.still_hard: A correct total can conceal an incorrect tax treatment. Weak source evidence and correlated extraction errors still need independent attention.
tasks.human_edge: Challenge plausible but unsupported entries and recognise when a procedural pass hides a substantive problem.
tasks.altitude: The reviewer's week shifts toward substantive exceptions and recurring control failures. They gain clearer authority to return incomplete packs for correction within the agreed review process.

reach.task: Design source-to-ledger controls for recurring financial close adjustments.
reach.learn: Control objectives, independent evidence and testing coverage.

evidence.claim: DataSnipper supports evidence-linked financial checks with team review and sign-off.
Baker Tilly Netherlands reported statement tick-and-tie falling from eight to two hours; this vendor-reported audit case does not establish tax-review savings.
Deterministic arithmetic and source comparisons require no model when validated fields and mappings are available.

assumptions: A validated source index and machine-readable return fields are available from preparation.
Unindexed evidence enters an exception queue; it cannot receive an automatic pass.
The check report supports final return approval and does not itself authorise filing.
Access work includes GDPR controls and consultation where national rules require it.
Build estimates exclude creating the upstream extraction service.
unknowns: Which native validations are enabled and which errors escape them.
Whether source extraction has been independently checked.
Whether return versions and reviewer identities are reliably recorded.
Required separation between preparation, checking and final approval.
research_questions: Which return fields and validation messages can be exported through supported interfaces?
Which independent checks detect errors shared by extraction and preparation?
new_work: Maintain field mappings and procedural checks.
Review unmatched evidence and unexplained variances.
Investigate recurring errors and overly noisy rules.
Verify that changed returns invalidate earlier check reports.
tasks.statement: Check data input or verify totals on forms prepared by others to detect errors in arithmetic, data entry, or procedures.

tasks.short: Answer client questions and advise on future tax choices.

steps.what: Read the client's question and identify the advice needed.
Gather the tax return, financial records and relevant client history.
Research applicable rules and note their relevance to the client's circumstances.

loop.input: Advice scope, client evidence pack and retrieved tax sources filtered by jurisdiction and tax year.
loop.output: Applicability notes with citations, assumptions and unresolved questions.
loop.check: Check source dates and citation passages automatically; the tax preparer verifies legal applicability.
loop.stop: One draft and one correction pass; conflicting or missing authority returns to manual research.
loop.why_not_simpler: Search can retrieve sources, but relating their prose to unusual client facts needs interpretation.

steps.what: Calculate alternative outcomes using the tax preparation system or a spreadsheet.
Discuss scenarios, clarify priorities and recommend a suitable course.
Write an advice note recording assumptions, recommendations and next actions.

loop.input: Structured agreed advice, verified applicability notes and calculated tax scenarios.
loop.output: Draft advice note with assumptions, citations and next actions.
loop.check: Every amount must match a scenario; every recommendation must match the recorded agreed advice.
loop.stop: One draft and one repair pass; failed checks leave a template for manual completion.
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates supply structure, but explanations vary with the client's priorities and circumstances.

steps.what: Check and send the advice note to the client.

tasks.design: A job on the {DATA_PLATFORM} assembles records from the tax preparation system in {OTHER}, the {ERP}, the {CRM} and {DOCS}, then runs versioned scenario calculations. A bounded drafting loop prepares cited research notes and an advice note; the tax preparer verifies the interpretation, holds the client conversation and approves sending through {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Records were scattered, tax sources changed, and client-specific explanations took time to write.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing exports and calculation engines can be stitched together faster with AI-assisted coding. Bounded drafting can work from verified facts and approved sources.
tasks.still_hard: Cross-border situations, incomplete facts and uncertain future law remain expensive. GDPR applies to client data; EU AI Act duties depend on the actual use.
tasks.human_edge: Understand what the client values, challenge risky assumptions and explain trade-offs the client can act on.

ambition.what: Pre-year-end tax scenario consultation for small-business clients.

tasks.altitude: The week shifts from assembling files to discussing choices and resolving uncertain cases. The preparer can propose scenario consultations; authority to approve tax positions does not automatically expand.

reach.task: Compare cash-flow outcomes across tax scenarios.
reach.learn: Cash-flow modelling, sensitivity analysis and the limits of the preparer's advice remit.

evidence.claim: AFAS Jonas supports income and corporate tax returns while the user remains responsible; this supports assisted preparation, not autonomous advice.
Versioned arithmetic can calculate scenarios; suitability and client priorities require human judgement.
GPT for Work reports incorrect cash-waterfall results in its model benchmark, supporting independent checks of generated figures.

assumptions: The setting is a tax practice within a mid-size European professional-services company.
{OTHER} denotes the tax preparation system throughout this job.
Advice involves substantial conversation, so the communication prior outweighs the low meeting share.
Remaining time estimates are design hypotheses; new exception work is additional.
unknowns: Which jurisdictions, tax years and client types the practice serves.
Whether the tax preparation system provides scenario calculations and usable exports.
Which sources the practice licenses and approves.
Whether employee consultation is required under national rules for the proposed implementation.
research_questions: Which recurring questions can use approved scenario templates?
How accurately can research drafts distinguish enacted rules from proposals?
Which scenario checks catch errors before advice reaches a client?
new_work: Verify cited interpretations and approve outgoing advice notes.
Resolve missing records and conflicting client facts.
Maintain tax-year rules, calculation tests and source permissions.
Monitor drafting failures and integration access.
tasks.statement: Answer questions and provide future tax planning to clients.

tasks.short: Explain applicable national and regional tax rules to individuals and small businesses.

steps.what: Receive the client's tax question and locate the relevant client file.
Find current official guidance for the jurisdiction, tax year and topic.
Determine how the rules apply and identify missing client facts.
Draft a plain-language explanation with relevant examples and caveats.

loop.input: The preparer's advice position, verified client facts and approved dated guidance.
loop.output: A plain-language explanation with source citations and labelled assumptions.
loop.check: Validate citations and dates; calculate examples deterministically; preparer checks meaning before delivery.
loop.stop: One draft and one revision per request; missing support returns to the preparer.
loop.why_not_simpler: Approved templates cover standard questions; varied client circumstances require tailored wording.

steps.what: Explain the position to the client and check their understanding.
Record advice delivered, assumptions and agreed follow-up actions.

tasks.design: Configure request capture in the {WORKFLOW} and a dated guidance library in {DOCS}, linked to official material in the {GOV_PORTAL}. A bounded drafting loop turns the preparer's approved position into a cited explanation, with deterministic example calculations. The preparer approves delivery during the client conversation and records agreed actions through structured fields.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current guidance, client facts and prior advice sit in separate places. Templates help, but tailoring and checking explanations consume expert time.
tasks.enabler_now: Filtered document search and bounded drafting can reduce preparation effort. Neither requires autonomous research or automatic delivery of advice.
tasks.still_hard: Ambiguous law, changing facts, language needs and client misunderstandings remain difficult. A valid citation alone does not establish correct advice.
tasks.human_edge: Notice confusion, explain trade-offs sensitively and establish whether the client understands what they must do.

ambition.what: First-time self-employed clients needing structured plain-language tax briefings.

tasks.altitude: More of the week goes to client understanding and difficult applications of law. The preparer can develop introductory briefings within existing advice permissions; formal advice authority does not change.

reach.task: Explain tax-sensitive cash-flow choices to small-business owners.
reach.learn: Cash forecasting, scenario assumptions and communication of uncertainty.

evidence.claim: Dated guidance retrieval, bounded drafting and human delivery are a proposed architecture; the digest contains no documented tax-explanation case.
Advice must be checked for jurisdiction, tax year, client facts and substantive applicability before delivery.

assumptions: The US wording is adapted to applicable national and regional European tax rules.
The guidance library has an assigned maintainer and effective dates.
Follow-up records use confirmed structured notes; recording or transcribing conversations is outside scope.
GDPR controls apply to advice records. Employee consultation follows applicable national rules.
Client conversations remain substantial even when preparation becomes faster.
unknowns: Supported jurisdictions, languages and client reading needs.
Permitted advice scope and escalation thresholds.
Whether guidance sources permit indexing and reuse.
Whether the proposed first-time self-employed group is currently underserved.
research_questions: Which authoritative sources provide reliable updates and historical tax-year guidance?
Which national rules govern tax-advice scope and advice-record retention?
new_work: Maintain guidance versions, expiry dates and reusable explanations.
Check draft citations, examples and omitted qualifications.
Review recurring client misunderstandings and improve briefings.
Confirm advice records reflect what was actually delivered.
tasks.statement: Explain federal and state tax laws to individuals and companies.

tasks.short: Arrange client appointments and send confirmations.

steps.what: Read the appointment request and identify duration, purpose and access needs.
Check staff availability, meeting duration and filing deadlines.
Exchange proposed times with the client until a slot is agreed.
Create the calendar appointment and send the client a confirmation.
Send a reminder with the appointment details and document checklist.

tasks.design: Configure client booking against the {CALENDAR}, using structured appointment types, availability rules and deadline buffers. The client selects a slot; the {WORKFLOW} creates the appointment and sends confirmations and reminders through {EMAIL}, while unusual requests enter a staff queue.
tasks.previous_blocker: Availability and appointment requirements were handled through individual mailboxes. Booking rules had not been agreed or configured.
tasks.enabler_now: Calendar booking, structured forms and scheduled reminders are established capabilities. Routine scheduling needs configuration rather than a model.
tasks.still_hard: Urgent cases, accessibility needs, cancellations and multi-person meetings still require coordination. Calendar details must follow GDPR data minimisation; national rules may affect staff-calendar access.
tasks.human_edge: Accommodate distressed clients and decide which urgent appointment deserves scarce capacity.

ambition.what: Self-service booking for shift workers who cannot call during office hours.

tasks.altitude: Routine scheduling leaves the preparer's week; exceptions and client care remain. They may prioritise urgent appointments within agreed capacity limits, without gaining authority over colleagues' working hours.

reach.task: Forecast appointment capacity around filing deadlines.
reach.learn: Capacity planning, appointment demand and deadline bottlenecks.

evidence.claim: Existing calendar and workflow capabilities can provide booking, confirmations and reminders without model reasoning.
Routine client-selected bookings can operate within approved availability rules without staff approval of each appointment.

assumptions: The baseline describes manually arranged appointments; some practices already automate them.
Mailbox exchanges take more time than the weak mail-share prior suggests.
Clients provide structured booking requirements and select their own slot.
Routine booking authority is delegated through approved calendar rules.
Zero remaining time applies to routine steps; exception handling remains additional work.
unknowns: Whether the existing {CALENDAR} supports external booking and required appointment types.
How often appointments need several staff members or special accommodation.
Which calendar access and consultation arrangements national rules require.
Whether clients need a telephone alternative.
Who may override deadline buffers and reserved capacity.
research_questions: Which appointment types can be booked without staff intervention?
How should urgent cases reach a person without exposing tax details?
Which reminder timing reduces missed appointments for these clients?
new_work: Handle urgent requests, special accommodations and booking failures.
Maintain appointment durations, buffers and staff availability.
Update document checklists and reminder templates.
Review access permissions and calendar synchronisation failures.

role_batches.altitude: The tax preparer spends less time transferring figures, searching guidance and rewriting notes. The week centres on disputed facts, defensible tax positions and client understanding; filing and advice authority remain subject to existing professional limits.
reach: Work with Accountants and Auditors on ledger-to-tax reconciliations.
Work with Financial Managers, Treasurers and Controllers on quarterly tax cash forecasts.
Work with Compliance Officers on guidance accuracy and advice escalation.
Work with Bookkeeping, Accounting, and Auditing Clerks on assisted intake for incomplete records.
skills_to_grow: Design and interpret source-linked reconciliation checks.
Maintain jurisdiction-specific eligibility rules and effective dates.
Review model drafts for unsupported facts and tax claims.
Explain uncertainty and choices in plain language.
Use cash forecasts to time tax planning discussions.
role_batches.ambitious_version: Provide a year-round small-business tax planning service combining quarterly liability reviews, pre-year-end relief planning and assisted intake, with qualified people approving consequential advice and tax positions.

role_batches.altitude: The role shifts from collecting, rekeying and recalculating toward evidence exceptions, defensible tax positions and client understanding. Existing signing and advice permissions remain; broader responsibilities need explicit delegation.
reach: Accountants: resolve recurring ledger classifications before tax preparation.
Compliance officers: maintain evidence-backed filing obligations and deadlines.
Financial managers: connect tax estimates to client cash-flow planning.
skills_to_grow: Versioned national tax rules and decision-table design.
Review of extracted facts and cited draft explanations.
Plain-language advice and checking client understanding.
Data access, retention and exception-management practices.
role_batches.ambitious_version: Offer small-business clients a quarterly tax-readiness service combining updated estimates, missing-evidence checks and an expert discussion of material changes.

role_batches.altitude: The tax preparer spends more of the week on client choices, atypical treatments and scope exceptions. Proposed delegation covers routine booking and bounded fee adjustments; substantive tax advice remains professionally accountable.
reach: Support accountants and auditors with documented book-to-tax treatment analysis.
Help financial managers review preparation margins and seasonal capacity.
Give billing clerks traceable approved fee records.
skills_to_grow: Scenario modelling and explanation of uncertainty.
Client interviewing and practical tax planning.
Data access, exception handling and integration checks.
role_batches.ambitious_version: Combine pre-year-end scenario consultations with an internal atypical-return desk, supported by traceable calculations and reviewed research. Use preparation margins and appointment demand to propose better service packages and seasonal staffing.

summary.basis: 100 baseline hours; equal weight per loaded task; step shares normalized within each task
